fact: KfW stated on 31 May 2023 that, on behalf of the German development ministry, it financed Benin's administrative network with EUR 10 million in a first phase, to which the government of Benin added a counterpart contribution of about EUR 4.8 million, that 187 authorities (ministries, the presidential office and prefectures) are connected, and that the next step, with a further EUR 14.3 million planned in a second phase, is to connect all municipalities in Benin to the administrative network.
title: Digitalisation makes authorities in West Africa more efficient
